create.title: Create a video
create.tagline: From a script to a narrated video, in one run
create.description: Write your script, pick a voice and a style, and Vimo builds the whole video.
create.desktopOnly: Video creation only works in the desktop app.

form.namePlaceholder: e.g.: The story of the Titanic
form.nameHint: Used for the project folder and the final file.
form.footerNote: Your video will show up in the library when it's done ✨

narration.label: Narration
narration.modeAiHint: Vimo reads your script with the voice you pick.
narration.modeUploadHint: Use your own recording as the narration.
narration.audioHint: Vimo transcribes your audio and uses that text to create the images. No need to write a script. Formats: mp3, wav, m4a, aac, ogg.

script.label: Script
script.placeholder: Write here the text to be narrated…
script.optionalPlaceholder: If you have the script you recorded the audio from, paste it here…

style.label: Visual style
style.hint: Only controls HOW the images look (aesthetics), not WHAT appears in them.

scenes.confirmHint: Vimo pauses and shows how many scenes it suggests.

image.evolinkHint: Faster (50 in parallel), a single preset.

quality.evolinkLowNote: Comes out in the video's shape (16:9 or 9:16). Cheapest.
quality.evolinkMediumNote: Comes out in the video's shape (16:9 or 9:16). Price/quality balance.
quality.evolinkHighNote: Comes out in the video's shape (16:9 or 9:16). Top quality.
